description_en: Updates the status of an approval instance under your Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 更新当前阿里云账号下审批实例状态
kebab_example: aliyun csas update-approval-status --approval-id approval-872b5e911b350000 --status Approved --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateApprovalStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the approval instance. Obtain the value from:

- [ListApprovals](~~ListApprovals~~): Query a list of approval instances in batches.

- [GetApproval](~~GetApproval~~): Query the details of an approval instance
parameters.help_zh:
审批实例ID。取值来源：
- [ListApprovals](~~ListApprovals~~)：批量查询审批实例列表。
- [GetApproval](~~GetApproval~~)：查询审批实例详情
parameters.name: approval_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the approval instance. Valid values:

- **Approved**: Approved.

- **Rejected**: Rejected
parameters.help_zh:
审批实例状态。取值：
- **Approved**：已通过。
- **Rejected**：已拒绝
parameters.name: status
